description.value: Why should bombs get to have all the fun setting things on fire? You can add a combustible additive to an alchemical poison. If a creature fails its initial saving throw against the poison, it also takes @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage. If a creature is already taking persistent fire damage, it instead takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its initial saving throw against the poison.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
